description: Restore AddChatDialog from a FAB on ChatListScreen so users can start a chat by recipient ID without the lobby
steps: Open the hub (ChatListScreen)
Confirm a FAB with the Add icon is visible
Tap FAB and verify AddChatDialog appears
Enter a recipient ID and confirm; navigate to chat/{canonicalId}
Dismiss dialog without submitting; hub remains usable
Run ./gradlew test

description: Keep the chat composer visible when the keyboard opens via windowSoftInputMode=adjustResize
steps: Open an existing chat
Focus the message input so the IME appears
Verify the TopAppBar does not disappear and MessageInput stays above the keyboard
Send a message and confirm it still appears in the list

description: Persist MessageStatus.SENT after a successful MQTT publish and ERROR on failure
steps: Send a text message with MQTT connected
Confirm the stored status becomes SENT (not stuck on SENDING)
Simulate a send failure and confirm ERROR
Cover the mapping in ChatRepositoryImplTest
Run ./gradlew test

description: Disconnect MQTT when the app leaves the foreground and reconnect on return, without ViewModels talking to MqttManager
steps: Launch the app and confirm MQTT connects (hub connection dot)
Background the process and confirm disconnect is invoked
Foreground the app and confirm reconnect
Incoming messages still persist through ChatRepository

description: Compare GitHub release tags with semver so equal or lower tags are not treated as updates
steps: Given VERSION_NAME 0.2.0, a tag v0.2.0 must not show UpdateScreen
A tag v0.2.1 or v0.3.0 must show as available
A tag v0.1.9 must not show as available
Add unit tests for the comparator
